bip380/no-uncompressed-derived-keys.noul: BIP-380. bip380/no-uncompressed-derived-keys.message: BIP-380: derived keys are never uncompressed; the enclosing expression decides the exact form.

bip380/hardened-normalization-on-export.noul: BIP-380. bip381/sh-top-level-only.noul: BIP-381. Requirement: `sh()` can only be used as a top level expression, since P2SH cannot be nested inside another script. bip381/sh-top-level-only.message: BIP-381: sh() is top level only.

bip381/pk-versus-pkh.noul: BIP-381. bip381/pk-versus-pkh.message: BIP-381: pk() is a bare pubkey CHECKSIG; pkh() is the P2PKH template.

bip382/wsh-nesting.noul: BIP-382. bip382/wsh-nesting.message: BIP-382: wpkh() and wsh() go at the top level or inside sh(), nowhere else.

bip382/compressed-keys-in-wsh.noul: BIP-382. criteria.false: Only compressed keys are allowed, or the hunk does not validate these keys.

bip382/compressed-keys-in-wsh.message: BIP-382: segwit descriptors accept compressed keys only.

bip382/nested-vs-native.noul: BIP-382. criteria.false: Each descriptor yields its own script, or the hunk does not build addresses from them.

bip382/nested-vs-native.message: BIP-382: wpkh() and sh(wpkh()) are different addresses for the same key.

bip383/key-count-limits.noul: BIP-383. bip383/key-count-limits.message: BIP-383: at most 3 bare, 15 in sh(), 20 in wsh().

bip383/threshold-encoding.noul: BIP-383. criteria.false: It is, or the hunk does not expand combo().

bip384/combo-expansion.message: BIP-384: combo() means P2PK and P2PKH, plus P2WPKH and sh(wpkh()) when the key is compressed.

bip384/combo-top-level-only.noul: BIP-384. Requirement: `combo()` can only be used as a top level expression, since it stands for several scripts rather than one. bip384/combo-top-level-only.message: BIP-384: combo() is top level only.

bip385/raw-and-addr-top-level.message: BIP-385: raw() and addr() are top level only.

criteria.false: They are watch-only, or the hunk does not classify solvability.

bip385/not-solvable.message: BIP-385: raw() and addr() are watch-only; nothing derived from them can be signed.

bip386/tr-top-level-only.message: BIP-386: tr() is top level only.

bip386/x-only-keys-inside-tr.message: BIP-386: every key under tr() is x-only, 32 bytes.
